name: claude-office-dashboard
description: Universal real-time agent dashboard for Claude Code: auto-setup hooks, per-project agent view, real subscription plan limits

commands.title: Claude Office: Open Dashboard in Editor
Claude Office: Emergency Stop / Resume Agents
Claude Office: Install Claude Code Hooks

claudeOffice.language.description: Dashboard UI language. "system" follows the OS language even when VSCode itself runs in English.

claudeOffice.hooks.autoSetup.description: Offer to install Claude Code hooks automatically when they are missing, and keep hook scripts up to date

claudeOffice.statusBar.enabled.description: Show a status bar item with agent activity; turns into a warning when Claude is waiting for your input

claudeOffice.roster.enabled.description: Discover agents from the project's .claude/agents/ folder and show them as idle immediately

claudeOffice.usage.enabled.description: Show plan usage panel (real subscription limits via your Claude Code login)

claudeOffice.usage.costSource.description: Additional cost-estimate bars (USD). "ccusage" spawns `npx ccusage` periodically

claudeOffice.usage.limitBlockUsd.description: Block limit USD (only for the ccusage cost bars)

claudeOffice.usage.limitWeeklyUsd.description: Weekly limit USD (only for the ccusage cost bars)

claudeOffice.usage.limitWeeklyOpusUsd.description: Opus weekly limit USD (only for the ccusage cost bars)

claudeOffice.scope.description: workspace = this window only; global = all Claude Code sessions

claudeOffice.agentRooms.markdownDescription:
Custom agent→room mapping. Merged **over** the built-in defaults. Example: `{"my-custom-agent": "backend", "design-agent": "frontend"}`.

Known rooms: `directors`, `backend`, `frontend`, `qa`, `security`, `devops`, `integrations`, `ai-lab`, `iot`, `lobby`.

Unknown agents are resolved by a keyword heuristic (e.g. `*-director` → directors, `react-*` → frontend); unmatched agents fall back to `lobby`.

scripts.test: tsc -p ./ && node out/test/eventParser.test.js && node out/test/types.test.js && node out/test/agentState.test.js && node out/test/hookConfig.test.js && node out/test/subscriptionUsage.test.js && node out/test/agentRoster.test.js && node out/test/emitAgentEvent.test.js && node out/test/stopFlag.test.js
